findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence.
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` value, "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", is Italian. Lithuanian users will see Italian text in the OTP setup step. Use a Lithuanian translation instead, for example "Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:".

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle now has a Traditional Chinese string.
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` value, "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", uses Traditional characters and Taiwanese wording (手機, 應用程式). This file is zh_CN, and the lines around it are Simplified. Use the Simplified form instead: "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：".

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence.
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle now reads "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see Italian text on the login OTP setup page. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Account UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to MessageFormat syntax.
findings.body: The account UI is a React/i18next app. The old value used `{{0}}` interpolation. The new `{0}` placeholders and the `{2,choice,...}` construct are not handled by i18next. If this key is rendered client-side, a multivalued-size validation error will show the literal placeholders and the choice pattern instead of the values. I could not see whether the server formats it first. Keep i18next syntax and use plural keys if pluralization is needed.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` placeholders to MessageFormat syntax.
findings.body: The admin UI resolves these keys with i18next. The rest of this file uses `{{...}}` interpolation, for example `{{error}}` and `{{fieldName}}`. i18next does not fill in `{0}` and does not understand `{2,choice,...}`. If the UI translates `error-invalid-multivalued-size` through i18next, as the old `{{0}}` syntax suggests, users will see raw text such as "Attribute {0} must have at least {1} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}". I could not check whether this key is formatted with MessageFormat on the server before it reaches the UI. Unless it is, keep the `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` placeholders and use i18next plural keys instead of a choice format.
